full_details: Morning prayer was at St Helen's. The north aisle pew was empty. You did not mark the almanac. At dinner the penny loaf was a thumb short of the notch, and it was still a penny. The afternoon was not kept. At the desk after dark you finished a sonnet about a player at a keyboard, changed one word in the couplet, and put the leaf in the folder. You said you would not go by the lane a third time.
one_sentence: You kept Sunday at St Helen's, ate a short penny loaf, and fair-copied a keyboard sonnet onto one leaf.
title: Morning prayer, and one sonnet leaf
